scope: Read-only exact public-facing name review of blank-name SFA rows at selected public shopping malls. No workbook edits, platform data, paid calls, or fabricated fields.

source_set.capture_method: Official page opened through web search and fetched directly via curl for SHA-256; page states F&B brands and mall unit numbers.

source_set.capture_method: Official current offer page opened through web search and fetched directly via curl for SHA-256.

summary.selection_note: A 20+ yield was not supported by exact current public-directory evidence in the bounded mall slice; ambiguous foodcourt/private-stall records were deliberately withheld.
